problemStatement.formal: Is R_sym(Q_n) << 2^n for hypercube Ramsey numbers?
problemStatement.plain: The n-dimensional hypercube Q_n is the graph on binary strings of length n, adjacent when they differ in exactly one bit. The formalization proves the Q_1 symmetric Ramsey base case and leaves the general bounded-ratio conjecture axiomatized.

proven: hypercubeAdj_one_iff identifies Q_1 adjacency with inequality.
two_in_symm_ramsey_set proves 2 belongs to the symmetric Ramsey set for Q_1.
ramseyNumberSymm_ge proves the conditional lower bound R_sym(Q_n) >= 2^n when the Ramsey set is nonempty.
open: Prove the general R_sym(Q_n) << 2^n conjecture without the erdos_181_conjecture_symm axiom.
Remove or replace the Tikhomirov asymptotic axiom with a formal proof or imported theorem.
knownResults.goal: Track the proved Q_1 base case separately from the axiomatized general hypercube Ramsey conjecture.

currentState.nextAction: Gallery/base-case proof is present; the general R_sym(Q_n) << 2^n conjecture remains open and axiomatized.
